result.reason: The added language supplies all preferred warranties, durations and remedies; its longer periods also satisfy fallback. The change is confined to the requested performance warranties and does not disturb the existing representations or Globix provision. Drafting quality is reduced by awkward repetition (“professional manner and in a workmanlike manner”), unclear control over selection among remedies, use of singular “its documentation” for multiple subjects, and wording that may make the listed remedies exclusive without cure procedures or deadlines.
